pois.name: De Kade
pois.description: De Kade is een uniek Surinaams en Chinees restaurant met vega(n) specialiteiten gelegen in het centrum van bruisend Rotterdam.

pois.name: Darwins nandoe
pois.intro: Darwin's rhea or the lesser rhea is a large flightless bird, the smaller of the two extant species of rheas. It is found in the Altiplano and Patagonia in South America.

pois.name: Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen
pois.intro: Municipal Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen is an art museum in Rotterdam in the Netherlands. The name of the museum is derived from its two most important donors, Frans Jacob Otto Boijmans and Daniël George van Beuningen.

pois.name: Euromast
pois.intro: Euromast is an observation tower in Rotterdam, Netherlands, designed by Hugh Maaskant constructed between 1958 and 1960. It was specially built for the 1960 Floriade, and is a listed monument since 2010.

pois.name: Markthal
pois.intro: The Markthal is a residential and office building with a market hall underneath, located in Rotterdam. The building was opened on October 1, 2014, by Queen Máxima of the Netherlands.

pois.name: Diergaarde Blijdorp
pois.intro: Diergaarde Blijdorp, officially Rotterdam Zoo, is a zoo located in the northwestern part of Rotterdam. It is one of the oldest zoos in the Netherlands, and has been operated by the Stichting Koninklijke Rotterdamse Diergaarde.

pois.name: KunstHAL
pois.intro: The Kunsthal is an art space in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. It opened in 1992.

pois.name: Wereldmuseum Rotterdam
pois.intro: The Wereldmuseum Rotterdam is an ethnographic museum, situated at Willemskade in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. The museum was founded in 1883 and shows more than 1800 ethnographic objects from various cultures in Asia, Oceania, Africa, the Americas and the Islamic heritage.

pois.name: SS Rotterdam
pois.intro: The fifth SS Rotterdam, also known as "The Grande Dame", is a former ocean liner and cruise ship, and has been a hotel ship in Rotterdam, Netherlands, since 2010. She was launched by Queen Juliana of the Netherlands in a gala ceremony on 13 September 1958, and was completed the following summer.

pois.name: Witte Huis
pois.intro: The Witte Huis or White House is a building and National Heritage Site in Rotterdam, Netherlands, built in 1898 in the Art Nouveau style. The building is 43 m tall, with 10 floors.

pois.name: World Port Center
pois.intro: World Port Centre is a 33-storey, 123.1 m skyscraper in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

pois.name: Natuurhistorisch Museum Rotterdam
pois.intro: The Natuurhistorisch Museum Rotterdam is a natural history museum located in Rotterdam, Netherlands. The museum opened in 1927.

pois.name: De verwoeste stad
pois.intro: The Destroyed City is a bronze memorial sculpture in the Dutch city of Rotterdam. It commemorates the German bombing of Rotterdam on 14 May 1940, which destroyed the medieval centre of the city.

pois.name: Museumpark
pois.intro: Museumpark is an urban park in Rotterdam, Netherlands, located between the Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen, Westersingel, Westzeedijk and the complex of the Erasmus MC, a medical centre affiliated with the Erasmus University. The park lies on the former land of the Hoboken family, who lived in the building that is since 1987 the Natuurhistorisch Museum Rotterdam.

pois.name: De Hef
pois.intro: De Hef, officially Koningshaven Bridge, is a vertical-lift bridge over the Koningshaven channel at the port of Rotterdam, Netherlands. Built in 1927, the bridge was part of the Breda–Rotterdam railway line until it was decommissioned in 1993.

pois.name: Chabot Museum
pois.intro: The Chabot Museum is a museum dedicated to the Dutch painter and sculptor Hendrik Chabot in Rotterdam in the Netherlands. The museum is housed in a monumental villa in the Museumpark, near the Museum Boijmans van Beuningen and the Netherlands Architecture Institute.

pois.name: Depot Boijmans Van Beuningen
pois.intro: Depot Boijmans Van Beuningen is an art depot of Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen in Rotterdam. It is the first publicly accessible art depot in the world.

pois.name: Nederlands Fotomuseum
pois.intro: The Netherlands Photo Museum is a photography museum in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, that was founded in 2003. The museum collection consists of many historical, social and cultural images from the 20th and 21st centuries, from the Netherlands and elsewhere.

pois.name: Maritiem Museum
pois.intro: The Maritime Museum Rotterdam is a maritime museum in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. Dedicated to naval history, it was founded in 1874 by Prince Henry of the Netherlands.

pois.name: Kunstinstituut Melly
pois.intro: Kunstinstituut Melly is a contemporary art house located in a former school building on Witte de Withstraat, in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. It was founded in 1990 and originally named after the street it was located on.

pois.name: Villa Zebra
pois.intro: Villa Zebra ist ein niederländisches Museum und Kunstlaboratorium für Kinder in Rotterdam. Es wurde 2001 unter dem Namen Stichting Villa Zebra Kinderkunsthal von Jet Manhro und Wim van Krimpen errichtet und war bis 2005 im Museumpark Rotterdam ansässig.

pois.name: Mariniersmuseum
pois.intro: Netherlands Marine Corps Museum is a museum on the history of the Netherlands Marine Corps. Since December 1995 it has been housed in a building on the Wijnhaven in Rotterdam.

pois.name: Nieuwe Instituut
pois.intro: Nieuwe Instituut is a cultural centre in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. It focuses on architecture, design, and digital culture.

pois.name: Rotown
pois.intro: Rotown is a music venue and a bar-restaurant in Rotterdam, Netherlands. It is located close to the city centre, on the Nieuwe Binnenweg.

pois.name: FG Restaurant
pois.intro: FG is a restaurant in Rotterdam, Netherlands. It is a fine dining restaurant that was awarded one Michelin star for the period 2010–2013, and two stars since 2014.

pois.name: Restaurant Amarone
pois.intro: Amarone is a restaurant in Rotterdam, Netherlands. It is a fine dining restaurant that is awarded one Michelin star in the period 2008–present.

pois.name: Restaurant Joelia
pois.intro: Joelia is a restaurant in Rotterdam, Netherlands. The restaurant received a Michelin star in 2016.

pois.name: Parkheuvel
pois.intro: Parkheuvel is a restaurant in Rotterdam, Netherlands. It is a fine dining restaurant that has been awarded one or more Michelin stars from 1990 to present.

pois.name: Fred
pois.intro: Fred is a restaurant in Rotterdam, Netherlands. It is a fine dining restaurant that was awarded one Michelin star for the period 2010–2013, and two stars since 2014.

pois.name: Eethuis Vlietlaan
pois.description: Kapsalon • Dürüm • Shoarma • Kebab • Döner • Turks

pois.name: Arboretum Trompenburg
pois.openingHours: Apr-Oct Mo 12:00-17:00; Apr-Oct Tu-Su 10:00-17:00; Nov-Mar Mo 12:00-16:00; Nov-Mar Tu-Su 10:00-16:00
pois.intro: Arboretum Trompenburg is a botanical garden in Rotterdam, Netherlands, which hosts a large collection of woody as well as herbaceous plants. It occupies an area of 7 ha and is situated 4 m below sea level, so a system of canals is used to drain the land.

pois.name: Historische Tuin Schoonoord
pois.intro: Park Schoonoord is een parkje van ongeveer 1,2 hectare groot in het Scheepvaartkwartier in Rotterdam. Het parkje ligt aan de Kievitslaan aan de westzijde van de voormalige kleinste polder van Nederland, de Muizenpolder, een buitendijks buitenplaatsengebied.

pois.name: Het Park
pois.intro: Het Park est un parc de Rotterdam, situé à l'ouest du Centre-ville. Ce parc est situé entre la Nouvelle Meuse, Parkhaven, la rue Westzeedijk et le quartier Scheepvaart.

pois.name: Zuiderpark
pois.intro: The Zuiderpark is a city park in the Rotterdam neighbourhood of Charlois.

pois.name: Luchtpark Hofbogen
pois.description: Roof garden created from former train station.
pois.intro: Het Hofbogenpark is een nieuw stadspark in ontwikkeling op het voormalige spoorviaduct van de Hofpleinlijn. Dit viaduct, dat sinds 1908 de verbinding vormde tussen Rotterdam en Den Haag, verloor zijn functie in 2010 toen de spoorlijn werd opgeheven.

pois.name: Botanische Tuin Afrikaanderwijk
pois.intro: De Botanische Tuin Afrikaanderwijk is een botanische tuin in de Rotterdamse Afrikaanderwijk. De botanische tuin aan het Afrikaanderplein is opgericht in 1923 als onderdeel van de HBS Van Oldenbarnevelt.

pois.name: De Plantage
pois.intro: De Oude Plantage is een klein stadspark in de Rotterdamse wijk Kralingen. Het park is gelegen tussen de Nieuwe Maas, de Maasboulevard en de nieuwbouwwijk De Esch op het oude Drinkwaterleidingterrein.

pois.name: Veerhaven
pois.description: Op de ligplaatsen is walstroom (230V) en drinkwater.

pois.name: Botanische Tuin Kralingen
pois.intro: De Botanische Tuin Kralingen is een botanische tuin in Rotterdam gelegen aan de Kralingse Plaslaan in de wijk Kralingen. De tuin beslaat 0,54 hectare en heeft een vijver met fontein, een verwarmde kas, een zadenhuisje, een medicinale tuin, een varentuin en een rosarium.

pois.name: Miniworld Rotterdam
pois.intro: Miniworld Rotterdam is de grootste overdekte miniatuurwereld van Nederland met een voorlopige oppervlakte van 650 m2 in schaal 1:87. Het opende op 30 maart 2007 aan het Weena in Rotterdam.

pois.name: Plaswijckpark
pois.intro: Plaswijckpark is a recreational and amusement park located on the shores of the Bergse Achterplas founded in 1923 between the districts of Hillegersberg and Schiebroek on the northern edge of Rotterdam, Netherlands. The park is owned by the Stichting Plaswijckpark.

pois.name: Rotterdam Cruise Terminal
pois.intro: The Rotterdam Cruise Terminal is a building on the Wilhelmina Pier, Rotterdam. The Cruise Terminal served as the arrival and departure point of Holland America Line and is considered part of the city’s social and industrial heritage.

pois.name: De Boeg
pois.intro: De Boeg ist ein Denkmal zu Ehren der rund 3500 Seeleute auf niederländischen Handelsschiffen, die im Zweiten Weltkrieg ums Leben kamen. Es wurde vom Bildhauer Fred Carasso entworfen und wurde in Rotterdam-Leuvehaven errichtet.

pois.name: Spelen bij Beelen
pois.intro: Spelen bij Beelen / Zuidyard is een attractiepark in aanbouw op het terrein van de voormalige AVR-verbrandingsoven in Rotterdam-Zuid. Het park is een initiatief van ondernemer Hennie van der Most.

pois.name: Schouwburgplein
pois.intro: Theatre Square is a plaza situated in the heart of the city of Rotterdam, and is flanked by the municipal theatre, concert hall, restaurants, and cafes. An urban stage and an interactive open space, the 12.250 square meter square is designed by West 8, the landscape architecture firm founded by Adriaan Geuze.
